text: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah.
Call on Me in the day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you shall honor and glorify Me."
"These things you have done and I kept silent; You thought that I was just like you. Now I will reprimand and denounce you and state the case in order before your eyes.
"He who offers a sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving honors Me; And to him who orders his way rightly [who follows the way that I show him], I shall show the salvation of God."
